name: Bhusawal

queries.query: Bhusawal Maharashtra official GIS cadastral map parcel property map site:gov.in
queries.result: First-party results identified Maharashtra Government land-record services (Mahabhumi/BhuNaksha), the Maharashtra Land Records Department, the Maharashtra State GIS portal, and an official MRSAC Bhusawal taluka village-map publication.

queries.result: First-party results identified the Maharashtra Land Records Department’s Marathi property-card and land-map services, including Mahabhunakasha (maps with land records), and official guidance describing village and survey-number maps. No Bhusawal parcel feature response was obtained.

freshResearch.method: First-party web discovery followed by bounded TLS-verified GET attempts. The public BhuNaksha viewer fetch timed out; no credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Maharashtra Revenue Department / Settlement Commissioner land-record gateway. It lists Bhulekh, property cards, digitally signed records and Mahabhunakasha maps with land records; it is a state custodian rather than proof of an open Bhusawal parcel API.

Official Maharashtra BhuNaksha public map viewer for state code 27. Search results describe plot-number selection and plot information, but the current viewer could not be fetched anonymously within the bounded timeout.

Official MRSAC Bhusawal taluka village map. It shows administrative/village boundaries, roads, rail and water features and identifies Land Record Department village-map data; it is not retained as parcel geometry.

Official Maharashtra State GIS portal powered by BharatMaps. Search discovery exposed administrative/GIS map functionality, but the viewer request timed out and no parcel layer or schema was verified.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds; no HTML, JavaScript configuration, service URL, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was obtained. This is a route failure, not evidence of citywide absence.
Official viewer fetch timed out; no parcel service configuration or bounded response was obtained.
Official Bhusawal taluka village map was identified. It is contextual map evidence, not a safe parcel-polygon response, so no geometry sample was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Maharashtra state land-record and GIS portals, plus official Bhusawal taluka village-map publication.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official state land-record service presence and Bhusawal taluka map publication; no open parcel feature endpoint or citywide geometry scope verified.

remainingUncertainty: The BhuNaksha viewer’s current JavaScript/configuration, public API route, Bhusawal village/urban unit identifiers, parcel schema, stable native identity, CRS, update currency and citywide completeness remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made. A timeout, map extent miss, login wall or unusable UI is not evidence of cadastral absence.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect the current BhuNaksha viewer through an available public route and request only bounded anonymous native ID-plus-geometry data for Bhusawal. Serial reviewer qualification remains required; runtime readiness stays held.
